# AliasFleet Agent Email Protocol (llms.txt)

> Programmable email infrastructure and isolated privacy aliases for AI agents, Browser-Use, Playwright, and Claude MCP.

## Overview
AliasFleet enables AI agents to provision dedicated forwarding addresses, receive inbound emails via instant HMAC-signed JSON webhooks, and process OTP verification codes without exposing real personal or corporate credentials.

- Base API: `https://api.aliasfleet.com`
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <afp_api_key>`
- Key Prefix: `afp_` (52 hex characters)
- Webhook Secret: `af_whsec_` (73 characters)

## Core Tools for AI Agents

### 1. Provision Agent Inbox
- Method: `POST /v1/aliases`
- Payload:
```json
{
  "description": "Agent Task or Name",
  "local_part": "agent-qa-42",
  "domain_id": "optional-custom-domain-uuid"
}
```
- Response (`201 Created`):
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "alias": {
    "id": "9f83a21b-4c7d-4e9a-8b7c-6d5e4f3a2b1c",
    "full_address": "agent-qa-42@aliasfleet.com",
    "active": true
  }
}
```

### 2. Stream Inbound Emails via Webhook
- Method: `POST /v1/webhooks/endpoints`
- Payload:
```json
{
  "url": "https://your-agent-server.com/webhooks/email",
  "format": "parsed_json"
}
```
- Webhook Headers sent on arrival:
  - `X-AliasFleet-Signature`: `t=timestamp,v1=hmac_sha256_hash`
  - `X-AliasFleet-Event`: `email.received`

### 3. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Setup
Add to `claude_desktop_config.json` or Cursor MCP settings:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aliasfleet": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/@aliasfleet/mcp-server/bin/cli.js"],
      "env": {
        "ALIASFLEET_API_KEY": "afp_your_key_here"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
Exposes tools:
- `aliasfleet_create_inbox`
- `aliasfleet_list_inboxes`
- `aliasfleet_setup_webhook`
- `aliasfleet_get_account_info`
